- **Built the style cast** (a96b24c): `style_cast` table + `cast_id` portraits with backfill, word-boundary prompt matching with aliases, `planRefs` (style refs always, portraits only for named members, description-only beyond caps), cast block in the composed prompt, Cast section + member dialog with Generate sheet, Inspector cast chips (auto/custom, ↺ Auto), MCP `create_style_profile` / `add_style_reference` / `set_cast_member` / `generate_cast_portrait` and `cast` on `generate_panel_image`. Unit, integration (local stack) and e2e (21/21) green. Not yet pushed or migrated to production.

### `styles.e2e.ts` is order-dependent under parallel runs

<details>

It presses ↓ in the new-comic dialog expecting its own style to be first, which means most
recently edited. When `cast.e2e.ts` or `generation.e2e.ts` edit a style at the same moment, a
different style is first. It passes alone and in the full suite. Select the style by name instead.

</details>
